title.narrative: Feed the Future Nigeria Rural Resilience Activity

description.narrative: (Nigeria): With FY 2022 funds this activity will: .Assist Nigerian farmers to recover from shocks and stresses;.Facilitate economic recovery for vulnerable households; and.Work with farmers and non-farm actors (such as input suppliers, aggregators, and processors) to develop market linkages, improve agricultural productivity, and promote non-farm enterprise opportunities. .Interventions will focus on women's empowerment to improve nutrition results, boost agricultural growth and productivity, and improve farm and non-farm livelihoods among the most vulnerable to increase economic opportunities for men, women, and youth. This activity will directly benefit over 560,000 individuals across the four northeast states of Adamawa, Borno, Gombe, and Yobe. .The activity operates on the premise that stimulating inclusive resilient market systems, that take into account the challenges and constraints of the Northeast operating environment, will systemically move individuals and households out of chronic vulnerability and improve the Northeast's economy. This transformation will set Nigeria on a path for increased stability, resilience, prosperity, and market inclusion. The activity will work within carefully selected value chains that have the potential to drive both economic expansion and inclusion. .The activity contributes to the Mission's Feed the Future strategy and JSP GOALS 1 and 2. The activity's workforce development programs, mentorship, and leadership training will target women and youth to build their capacity and skills while preparing them for greater leadership roles in their communities. This approach enables individuals and communities to engage in strong and sustainable market systems rather than continuing to rely on humanitarian assistance. The activity promotes climate-smart agriculture to strengthen the capacity to withstand shocks and stresses, which include those that are as a result of climate change....
